blocks.raw:
<Tip>
Memory aid for CSI divisions: Divisions 00-01 are administrative. Divisions 02-09 are the "core construction divisions" most tested on the LEA. Divisions 10-49 cover building systems (interior construction, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection). Master the core divisions 03-09 first. Always remember: 03=Concrete, 04=Masonry, 05=Metals, 06=Wood, 07=Thermal & Moisture, 08=Openings, 09=Finishes.
</Tip>

Students put window specifications in Division 09." correction="Division 08 is specifically doors, windows, glazing, and hardware. Division 09 is interior finishes like paint, flooring, and ceiling systems. Windows belong in Division 08, even if they involve finish work." />

props.mistake: Confusing 'Division 08: Openings' (doors, windows, hardware) with 'Division 09: Finishes' (paint, flooring, ceilings). Students put window specifications in Division 09.
props.correction: Division 08 is specifically doors, windows, glazing, and hardware. Division 09 is interior finishes like paint, flooring, and ceiling systems. Windows belong in Division 08, even if they involve finish work.

props.mistake: Placing waterproofing specifications in Division 03 (Concrete) instead of Division 07 (Thermal & Moisture Protection). Students think 'waterproofing concrete means Division 03'.
props.correction: Waterproofing membranes, sealants, and moisture control systems belong in Division 07, even if they're applied over concrete or masonry. Division 03 specifies the concrete itself; Division 07 specifies the protection layer.
